Watts printed the hymn under 2 Corinthians 5:1, 5–8. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Now we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands. 5And God has prepared us for this very purpose and has given us the Spirit as a pledge of what is to come. 6Therefore we are always confident, although we know that while we are at home in the body, we are away from the Lord. 7For we walk by faith, not by sight. 8We are confident, then, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord. 2 CORINTHIANS 5:1, 5–8 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ 2 CORINTHIANS 5
There is a house not made with hands, Eternal and on high: And here my spirit waiting stands Till God shall bid it fly. STANZA I
